body: Suresh, aapke last message se aage — “Yes good idea, what would it look like”. Mylari South Indian Cafe ke liye concrete version yeh hai: base price Weekday Lunch Thali @ ₹149 rakhiye, phir ek hi message mein headcount, veg/Jain split, delivery window aur GST invoice details maang lijiye. Aapki listing pe pichhle 30 din mein 12,400 views, 88 calls aur 3.2% CTR hai, toh yeh already maujood audience tak jaata hai. CONFIRM bhejiye, main ready-to-send copy format kar deti hoon — ya EDIT ke saath ek badlaav bata dijiye.
rationale: The merchant already committed, so the message skips qualification, quotes their own words back, and delivers a concrete package.

body: Padma, picking up your last message — “Hi I want to add a kids yoga program — what should it look like?”. Here is the concrete version for Zen Yoga Studio: First Month @ ₹499 as the entry point, a fixed weekday slot, and a 4-week block so people can commit to something finite. Your listing is at 880 views, 18 calls and 6.2% CTR in the last 30 days, so this goes out to an audience that already exists. Reply CONFIRM and I will format the ready-to-send copy, or EDIT with the one thing you want changed.
rationale: The merchant already committed, so the message skips qualification, quotes their own words back, and delivers a concrete package.

body: Hi Aditya, Karim's Salon here. Your appointment is tomorrow. Reply CONFIRM to keep it, or RESCHEDULE and we will move you to the next open slot.
rationale: Next-day reminder sent on behalf of the merchant, with no invented time when the schedule is not supplied, and one two-way CTA.

body: Hi Riya, Beauty Lounge by Renu se. Kal aapki appointment hai. CONFIRM bhejiye toh slot pakka, ya RESCHEDULE likhiye — hum agla khaali slot de denge.

body: Ramesh, summer 2026 wala shift shuru ho chuka hai: ORS demand +40, sunscreen demand +38, antifungal demand +45, aur cold cough demand -60. Malviya Nagar mein yeh decide karta hai ki log pehle kya maangenge — discount nahi. Main agle chaar hafton ke liye ek page ki shelf aur counter priority list bana doon? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.

body: Dr. Meera, ek session hai jiske liye time block karna banta hai — IDA Delhi: Digital impressions — 2026 state of the art, 2 May, 7pm ko, 2 CDE credits, members ke liye free. IDA Delhi chapter calendar ne list kiya hai. Aise sessions ki seats reminder se pehle bhar jaati hain. YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Time-bound professional opportunity with date, credits, fee and source, plus a scarcity reason and a single scheduling action.

body: Namaste Mr. Sharma, Apollo Health Plus Pharmacy se. Aapki monthly medicines — metformin, atorvastatin, aur telmisartan — ka stock 28 Apr tak chalega. Free Home Delivery > ₹499. Aapka delivery address saved hai. REFILL bhejiye, hum ready rakh denge — ya prescription badla ho toh CHANGE likhiye.
rationale: Exact molecules and run-out date from the record, saved-delivery state, and a confirmation CTA that also catches prescription changes.

body: Hi Vivaan, Bright Smile Dental here. Your follow-up is due. Reply YES and we will send you this week's open slots, or STOP if you would rather not be reminded.
rationale: The refill label is inconsistent with a non-pharmacy merchant, so the message degrades to a safe follow-up reminder and names no medicine.

body: Dr. Meera, Smile Studio 8 Apr ko 1.3 km door khula hai, Dental Cleaning @ ₹199 ke saath. Main price kaatne ko nahi kahungi — woh ek move wapas nahi hota. Main ek sharper listing comparison bana doon, aapki asli strength par? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.

body: Suresh, Indiranagar ke paas ek naya competitor khula hai. React karne se pehle: aapki listing par pichhle 30 din mein 12,400 views, 88 calls aur 3.2% CTR hai, aur Weekday Lunch Thali @ ₹149 live hai — yeh asli base hai, panic wali baat nahi. body: Lakshmi, ek operator sawaal — aapki listing par pichhle 30 din mein 4,980 views, 62 calls aur 4.8% CTR hai aur Haircut @ ₹99 live hai. body: Pooja, the festive stretch is close, and Koramangala starts searching before it arrives. A flat discount is the weakest version of this. Built on 3 FREE Trial Classes, and with your listing at 5,934 views, 65 calls and 4.2% CTR in the last 30 days, it actually lands. Want the post draft? Reply YES, or STOP.
rationale: Seasonal timing paired with a real service+price anchor, explicitly rejecting the generic percentage discount.

body: Vikas, Sunrise Medicos abhi tak Google par unverified hai. Unverified hote hue bhi listing par pichhle 30 din mein 720 views, 14 calls aur 4.1% CTR hai — yaani demand badge ke bina bhi aa rahi hai. Verify karne ke baad estimate: 30% zyada visibility, postcard or phone call se. Aapke das minute lagenge. Main teen exact steps ek message mein bhej doon? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Quantified listing gap with the supplied uplift estimate and verification route, framed as a small effort against demand the merchant is already earning.

body: Padma, calls moved up 15% over the last 7 days, most likely from kids yoga post. Right now — 880 views, 18 calls and 6.2% CTR in the last 30 days. Attention like this fades in about a week, and the cheapest way to hold it is to post the same thing again while people are still looking. Want me to draft that follow-up post around First Month @ ₹499? Reply YES, or STOP.
rationale: Positive movement stated with its real magnitude, a time-decay reason to act now, and one repeatable next post.

body: Dr. Meera, Dental Council of India circular 2026-11-04 se ek compliance update: Maximum dose per IOPA exposure drops from 1.5 mSv to 1.0 mSv. E-speed film passes at the new limit; D-speed does not. Digital RVG sensors unaffected. Yeh 15 Dec se effective hai. Audit your X-ray setup before Dec 15; document E-speed or RVG in your SOPs. Aapki Lajpat Nagar listing par pichhle 30 din mein 2,410 views, 18 calls aur 2.1% CTR hai, toh announce karne se pehle hi patients poochhenge. Main 5-point audit checklist aur ek line jo aapka front desk bol sake bana doon? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Source-cited regulation with the exact effective date, connected to the merchant's own listing traffic, resolved by one compliance artifact.
